title: Effective, End and Notice Dating Terms of the Ridgecrest RxSecure Plans
content:
Four dating terms are written into each Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan: the rule that turns an accepted election into a coverage start date, the rule that turns an accepted disenrollment into a coverage end date, the months of retroactive coverage the plan may accept on a CMS-directed correction, and the latest date each year by which the annual notice of change must be mailed.

| Plan | Rule turning an accepted election into a coverage start date | Rule turning an accepted disenrollment into a coverage end date | Months of retroactive coverage the plan may accept on a CMS-directed correction | Annual notice of change mailed by (month and day) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | the first of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | 3 | 09-30 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | the first of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | 3 | 09-30 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | the first of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | 3 | 09-30 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | the first of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | 3 | 09-30 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | the first of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | 6 | 09-30 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | the first of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | 6 | 09-30 |

Of the four terms only the retroactive allowance moves with the plan held: 3 months on the four lower plans, and 6 months on Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) and Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP). The start-date rule, the end-date rule and the notice date of 09-30 are written identically on all six plans.
